note: Alberta Parks campground in the forest along the east shore of Lac Cardinal, about 5 km northwest of Grimshaw off Hwy 35: hand launch and pier, hiking trails, playground, picnic shelter. Low water ended trailer launching in 2025 (hand launch only). --Claude
